verdict.rationale: Alloy is a fraud and KYC decisioning platform, so inspecting and overriding automated decisions is a fair question to ask of it. The pack shows how to inspect evaluation results: per-service execution status, warnings, and the evaluations[] array. But no documented workflow lets a user override an automated decision while preserving its original evidence and rationale. The only hints are a passing webhook mention that "a manual review occurs" and the marketing phrase "fully auditable agentic automation", which do not document an override capability.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can inspect and override an automated remediation decision while preserving its original evidence and rationale
